files.README.md:
# crypt-keeper

    npm install -g crypt-keeper
    crypt seal diary "it was a dark and stormy night" --key raven
    crypt open diary --key raven

Requires node >= 0.6. (c) 2012

vitals.name: crypt-keeper
vitals.description: Seal secret notes into the crypt. A Node 0.8 command line toy.

deps.name: optimist
deps.cause: Deprecated and unmaintained since 2014; the author points to yargs.

deps.name: left-pad
deps.cause: The 2016 left-pad incident package. String.prototype.padStart is native since ES2017.

deps.name: mkdirp
deps.cause: fs.mkdir({ recursive: true }) is native since Node 10.12.

deps.name: mocha
deps.cause: Legacy test runner; node:test is built into Node 20+.

action.reason: Replaced by the generated node:test suite.

deps.name: rimraf
deps.cause: fs.rm({ recursive: true, force: true }) is native since Node 14.14.

configs.title: Travis CI config
configs.cause: travis-ci.org shut down in 2021; targets Node 0.6, 0.8. CI has been silently dead.
configs.remedy: Replace with a GitHub Actions workflow on Node 20/22.

configs.title: engines.node ">=0.6"
configs.cause: Pinned to a Node.js release that reached end-of-life years ago.

configs.title: No lockfile
configs.cause: Installs are not reproducible; the dependency tree drifts on every install.
configs.remedy: Commit the package-lock.json generated by the first `npm install`.

configs.title: No license
configs.cause: Nobody can legally reuse the resurrected code.

mocha@1.7.0 → removed — Replaced by the generated node:test suite.

patches.after:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test

reasons: Pins the resurrected runtime to Node 22 LTS
